objective: Port everything back to our game from the decomp

verified.numeric_primitives: Signed 16.16 multiply/divide and two uint32 RNG recurrences match 317 native executable cases. Fixed arithmetic is not yet connected to movement.
verified.runtime_ammo_primitives: Addition (004C2FB0), spending (004C3010) and the ordinary-weapon availability path (004C2EE0) match 120 original-x86 cases executed in Unicorn 2.1.4. Addition and spending are integrated across weapon and utility actions and crate pickups. Negative/unlimited stock survives use; arbitrary 3/9-item caps are removed. Weapon delays are now connected through the browser turn adapter; special availability rules remain unported.
verified.delay_countdown: Counter block 004E71BE and countdown 004E6630 match 16 original-x86 cases, covering two banks, first/subsequent turns, bypass, signed overflow, negative delays and reserved slot zero. Numerical fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/delays.json.
verified.sprite_resource_ids: Extracted all 767 descriptors from executable resource table 00564A78, passed to the sprite loader at 004CBB50. Descriptor fields are ID, filename pointer and flags; terminated at 00566E6C. Every referenced sprite exists in imported assets. Reproducible with tools/armageddon/sprite-table.py; result src/armageddon/sprite-ids.json.
verified.freeze_dispatch_and_animation: Original x86 block 004FCF8B sends event 0x411 with the user team ID in all six tested teams. Original 004F5C80 queues [0x242,0x248] after animation 0x23F, otherwise clears and queues [0x23C,0x248]. Five input animations verified in Unicorn. IDs resolve to wicelk2/wicestnd and wicelk3/wicestnd. Fixture tests/fixtures/armageddon/freeze.json. Sound descriptor IDs 0x18/0x19/0x6A resolve to freeze.wav/unfreeze.wav/frozenwormimpact.wav.
verified.animation_player: Original x86 sampler 004B0260, metadata 004AFC10 and queue routines 004FD270/2B0/3B0/4B0 match 224 frame samples, 15 real sprite metadata records, eight 120-tick queue traces and 42 queue API operations. Native 0x51E tick delta, fixed-point rates, loop/ping-pong flags, queue capacity and controlled progress are integrated. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/animation.json.
verified.weapon_animation_selector: 004FA490 matches all 71 weapon records captured from the original initializer under controlled inputs. Eleven browser weapons now select the corresponding native sprite, including throw, mine/dynamite, airstrike and bat poses. This does not establish native scheme defaults or full weapon behavior.
verified.weapon_equip: 004F61E0 equip transition matches 1,533 original-x86 cases across all 71 controlled-input weapon records, three previous states, seven angles and three rope modes. Covers link queues, clear/preserve behavior, initial strip progress, control mode, signed quantization and weapon limits. Animation interface calls are observed; only rope-mode lookup is supplied. Fixture: tests/fixtures/armageddon/equip.json.

partial.simulation_clock: 50 Hz integrated. Original input queues, frame dispatch, pause handling and fast-forward remain unported.
partial.random_streams: Gameplay and cosmetic streams integrated. Original caller masks, draw order and map RNG remain unported.
partial.weapon_configuration: tools/armageddon/weapon-oracle.py executes the original 004B90A0 initializer with explicit controlled inputs and captures all 71 final records. Local output: .local-research/armageddon/oracle/weapons-zero.json. Context is zeroed except special-weapon enable and two nonzero percentage divisors; localized name getters return empty strings. This is not a standard-match profile. Field semantics, native scheme defaults and per-weapon state machines still need tracing.
partial.decompile_coverage: Initial automatic analysis missed the 6,460-byte team-event handler at 004E6810. Recovered separately in Ghidra. Its 0x41C branch calls delay countdown 004E6630 only when the counter at task+0x60 exceeds one; global inventory+0x2C10 controls counter increments and availability bypass. Event routing and counter lifecycle still need full tracing. Original 8,025 exported functions must not be treated as complete executable coverage.
partial.original_media: User explicitly requested original sprites, animations and sounds, superseding the procedural-only art preference. Imported 770 SPR animations (14,273 frames), 123 effects and 49 voice banks (2,692 samples), browsable in armageddon.html. Core worm states, eleven weapon poses, frozen entry/idle and gameplay effect mappings are integrated. Runtime uses original sprite rates and loop flags. Gallery preview remains 25 fps. Remaining transitions, utility art, HUD, sound priorities and voice triggers require wiring.
partial.weapon_delays: 11 identified weapon slots now support saved per-weapon delays, HUD lock/countdown labels, selection/firing gates and AI filtering. Browser beginTurn advances each team separately, with frozen squads thawed before play; settings reset delays per island, including stockpile rounds. Full native event scheduling remains unported; the thaw order now follows the recovered team handler. Native defaults remain unknown, so existing presets stay zero-delay. Daily islands ignore custom delays. Utility delays, original unlock notifications, full 0x41C routing and bypass lifecycle remain unported. Sticky and thrown napalm are browser variants without asserted native identities.
partial.freeze: Replaced incorrect enemy-turn skip with own-team protection and thaw at the next own turn. Static trace: team handler 004E6810 filters 0x411 by team and broadcasts 0x412 at start of 0x41C; worm handler 004D97F0 sets state 0x88, thaws to 0x65, bypasses health damage for 0x404/0x433, suppresses horizontal impulse, and excludes frozen worms from poison events 0x426/0x439. Browser damage/poison and blast/shotgun/bat gates updated; drowning remains lethal. Native entry/idle sprites integrated using original metadata rates and the verified native queue; original freeze/thaw/impact samples now play. Team activation/thaw sounds play once per team in the browser, with native per-worm priority arbitration still unported. Native collision/impulse magnitudes, poison timing, cast and thaw transitions, and sound priority remain unported. AI still uses the browser heuristic, now targets its own squad.
partial.animation_state_graph: Native player, weapon selector and equip link queues integrated. Entering a weapon pose from browser locomotion/idle uses native idle-entry queues; switching directly between weapon poses skips the idle link. This browser-to-native state mapping remains an adapter. The complete original event/state graph is unported. The pure equip function also reproduces native angle/control changes, but live aim degrees and zero-rate locomotion progress remain browser-driven. Original firing, recoil, slope, death lifecycle and utility transitions remain unported.

constraints: Original media imported from the user-provided ISO at their explicit request. Native SPR pixels are decoded directly without JPEG/PNG resampling. Executables and decompiled listings remain private. Current regression tests do not establish full gameplay equivalence.
